test_title: PYST 17: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 17th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Convert the following sentence from passive to active voice:

The reports had been finalized by the clerk before submission.

options.text: The clerk finalizes the reports before submission.
The clerk had finalized the reports before submission.
The clerk was finalizing the reports before submission.
The clerk is finalizing the reports before submission.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
__ 
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence. 
 
• In the given passive voice sentence: "The reports had been finalized by the clerk before submission." 
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "the clerk" at the beginning. 
 
• Change the passive verb form "had been finalized" to the active voice form "had finalized." 
 
• Ensure the object "the reports" and the phrase "before submission" remain in their respective places for clarity. 
 
Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**. 
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"The clerk had finalized the reports before submission."* 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 
 
 
• **Option 1: **"The clerk finalizes the reports before submission." – Incorrect because the tense is not maintained (present tense instead of past perfect). 
 
• **Option 3: **"The clerk was finalizing the reports before submission." – Incorrect because the tense is not maintained (past continuous instead of past perfect). 
 
• **Option 4: **"The clerk is finalizing the reports before submission." – Incorrect because the tense is not maintained (present continuous instead of past perfect).
